key_highlights: ASX shed $90bn in a week as rate-rise fears and oil price surge pressured miners and banks
Iron ore entering a 'bloodletting' phase, pressuring BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX
Oil prices exploded as OPEC+ suppression failed; fuel prices to rise 30c in Australia
AUD smashed on growth scare; RBA flagged rental inflation as key concern
ANZ.AX announced 3,500 job cuts amid restructuring; banks under pressure from rising bond yields
Housing prices crashing with first-home buyer surge; no spring bounce in auction market
Mining cap raises accelerating (Canaccord-led); Sunstone Metals, Manuka Resources in focus
Global AI chip cycle strong (TSM record month, Nvidia, Marvell) but HBM shortage pressures GPU economics
Woolworths.WOW breached 'Price Freeze' on four staples, raising consumer cost-of-living concerns
Superannuation reform debate intensifying; populism vs. structural integrity tension

sectors.trend: Sharp negative. Iron ore 'bloodletting' underway; ASX miners leading the $90bn index decline. Cap raises accelerating as smaller miners seek liquidity. Gold underperforming ('gold schmould').
sectors.implications: BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX face margin compression. Smaller miners (Sunstone Metals, Manuka Resources, PolarX) see speculative flows but dilution risk from cap raises. Gold miners (NVA.AX, GSG.AX) lack safe-haven bid.

sectors.trend: Negative. Rising bond yields and rate fears pressure valuations. ANZ.AX cutting 3,500 jobs signals cost discipline but execution risk. Net interest margin pressure from rate cycle uncertainty.
sectors.implications: CBA.AX, NAB.AX, WBC.AX, ANZ.AX face dual pressure: higher funding costs vs. credit cycle concerns. ANZ restructuring may support near-term EPS but signals weak loan growth.

sectors.trend: Mixed-to-positive for producers, negative for consumers. Oil 'exploded' as suppression failed. Santos preservation highlighted structural vulnerability. Fuel prices rising 30c.
sectors.implications: Santos.STO, Woodside.WDS benefit from oil spike but face political/regulatory overhang. Airlines (QAN.AX) and transport hit by fuel cost pass-through. Consumer staples under margin pressure.

sectors.trend: Negative. Woolworths.WOW breached price freeze on staples. Cost-of-living squeeze intensifying. Housing crash boosting first-home buyers but overall consumer confidence weak.
sectors.implications: WOW.AX, WES.AX face margin pressure from input costs. Housing-linked REITs (GPW.AX, ICPS.AX) pressured by rental inflation concerns and falling property values.

sectors.trend: Neutral-to-positive. Global AI chip cycle robust (TSM record, Nvidia, Marvell). Australian healthcare stable. Bird flu in sea lions a minor biosecurity flag.
sectors.implications: CSL.AX, SGH.AX provide defensive exposure. Global AI capex (TSM, Nvidia, Oracle) supports sentiment but HBM shortage may cap GPU upside. Limited direct ASX tech exposure.

sectors.trend: Negative. Housing prices crashing, no auction bounce. RBA worried about rental inflation. Social rental development in Perth signals policy shift. NZ correction still running.
sectors.implications: Property REITs (GPW.AX, VMC.AX) face cap-rate expansion risk. Construction (WBC-linked) may see social housing pipeline. First-home buyer surge could support volume but not prices.

risk_assessment.mitigation: Hedge energy exposure; favour domestic producers (WDS.AX, STO) over importers; monitor RBA commentary on pass-through

risk_assessment.mitigation: Reduce BHP.AX/RIO.AX/FMG.AX weightings; favour diversified or gold-exposed miners; watch cap-raise dilution

risk_assessment.mitigation: Overweight export-oriented equities; consider AUD-hedged international exposure; monitor RBA intervention signals

opportunities.rationale: Iron ore bloodletting hurts pure-plays; gold miners and diversified names offer relative resilience

defensive_moves.rationale: AUD 'smashed' on growth scare; rising fuel imports worsen current account; preserve capital

defensive_moves.recommendation: Avoid speculative small-cap miners amid cap-raise wave
defensive_moves.rationale: Canaccord-led mining cap raises signal liquidity stress; dilution risk elevated

market_outlook.short_term: Bearish. ASX likely to extend losses as oil-driven inflation fears keep rate-cut expectations at bay. Iron ore weakness and AUD depreciation create a negative feedback loop. Banks and miners remain under pressure. RBA rental inflation commentary may trigger further volatility. Expect 3–5% further downside in ^AXJO over 1–3 months.
market_outlook.long_term: Cautiously constructive. Housing correction may stabilise within 6–12 months, supporting first-home buyer demand. Global AI capex cycle (TSM, Nvidia) provides a structural growth narrative. Superannuation reform, if enacted, could unlock long-term capital flows. Iron ore may find a floor as China stimulus emerges. Key variable is RBA's response to oil-driven inflation vs. growth slowdown.
